self introduction.beginner: Tell me about yourself in 30 seconds.
self introduction.intermediate: Give a concise 1-minute professional introduction highlighting your background.
self introduction.advanced: Deliver a compelling pitch introducing your professional profile and core interests.

daily conversation.beginner: Describe your morning routine in simple words.
daily conversation.intermediate: Talk about a hobby you are passionate about and why you enjoy it.
daily conversation.advanced: Reflect on how you balance your studies, personal health, and hobbies daily.

college.beginner: What is your favorite subject in college and why?
college.intermediate: Summarize the objectives and key findings of a class project.
college.advanced: Defend the technical design choices made in your main project during a viva Q&A.

internship interviews.beginner: Why are you interested in applying for this internship?
internship interviews.intermediate: Tell me about a challenge you faced during a project and how you handled it.
internship interviews.advanced: How do your key strengths align with the technical requirements of this internship role?

workplace communication.beginner: How do you introduce yourself to a new colleague at work?
workplace communication.intermediate: How would you structure a polite email or message requesting feedback from a manager?
workplace communication.advanced: Deliver a concise project status update highlighting accomplishments, risks, and next steps.

confidence building.beginner: Speak for 30 seconds about something you feel proud of achieving.
confidence building.intermediate: Present a short 1-minute argument explaining an idea to improve campus life.
confidence building.advanced: Deliver an impromptu 1.5-minute response on how to stay motivated during exams.
